traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ θάπτων αὐτούς , καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et non erit qui sepéliat eos : ipsi et uxóres eórum , fílii et fíliæ eórum :
traditions.KJV: and they shall have none to bury them , them , their wives , nor their sons , nor their daughters :

16.english_reference: for I will pour their wickedness upon them

traditions.VUL: et effúndam super eos malum suum .
traditions.KJV: for I will pour their wickedness upon them .

17.english_reference: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵי הֶם֙ אֶת הַ דָּבָ֣ר הַ זֶּ֔ה

traditions.VUL: Et dices ad eos verbum istud :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them ;

17.english_reference: Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day ,

traditions.WLC: תֵּרַ֨דְנָה עֵינַ֥ י דִּמְעָ֛ה לַ֥יְלָה וְ יוֹמָ֖ם
traditions.LXX: Καταγάγετε ἐπ᾽ ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν δάκρυα ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς

traditions.KJV: Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ μὴ διαλιπέτωσαν ,
traditions.VUL: et non táceant :
traditions.KJV: and let them not cease :

17.english_reference: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach ,

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ שֶׁ֨בֶר גָּד֜וֹל נִשְׁבְּרָ֗ה בְּתוּלַת֙ בַּת עַמִּ֔ י

traditions.KJV: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach ,

traditions.WLC: מַכָּ֖ה נַחְלָ֥ה מְאֹֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ πληγῇ ὀδυνηρᾷ σφόδρα .
traditions.VUL: plaga péssima veheménter .
traditions.KJV: with a very grievous blow .

18.english_reference: If I go forth into the field , then behold the slain with the sword !

traditions.WLC: אִם יָצָ֣אתִי הַ שָּׂדֶ֗ה וְ הִנֵּה֙ חַלְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב

traditions.KJV: If I go forth into the field , then behold the slain with the sword !

18.english_reference: and if I enter into the city , then behold them that are sick with famine !

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם֙ בָּ֣אתִי הָ עִ֔יר וְ הִנֵּ֖ה תַּחֲלוּאֵ֣י רָעָ֑ב

traditions.KJV: and if I enter into the city , then behold them that are sick with famine !

18.english_reference: yea , both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי גַם נָבִ֧יא גַם כֹּהֵ֛ן סָחֲר֥וּ אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ וְ לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ

traditions.KJV: yea , both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not .

traditions.WLC: הֲ מָאֹ֨ס מָאַ֜סְתָּ אֶת יְהוּדָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: Μὴ ἀποδοκιμάζων ἀπεδοκίμασας τὸν Ἰούδαν ,
traditions.VUL: Numquid proíciens abiecísti Iudam ?
traditions.KJV: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah ?

traditions.WLC: אִם בְּ צִיּוֹן֙ גָּעֲלָ֣ה נַפְשֶׁ֔ ךָ

traditions.VUL: aut Sion abomináta est ánima tua ?
traditions.KJV: hath thy soul lothed Zion ?

19.english_reference: why hast thou smitten us , and [ there is ] no healing for us ?

traditions.WLC: מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ הִכִּיתָ֔ נוּ וְ אֵ֥ין לָ֖ נוּ מַרְפֵּ֑א
traditions.LXX: ἵνα τί ἔπαισας ἡμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἴασις ?
traditions.VUL: quare ergo percussísti nos , ita ut nulla sit sánitas ?
traditions.KJV: why hast thou smitten us , and [ there is ] no healing for us ?

19.english_reference: we looked for peace , and [ there is ] no good

traditions.WLC: קַוֵּ֤ה לְ שָׁלוֹם֙ וְ אֵ֣ין ט֔וֹב
traditions.LXX: ὑπεμείναμεν εἰς εἰρήνην , καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἀγαθά ·
traditions.VUL: exspectávimus pacem , et non est bonum :
traditions.KJV: we looked for peace , and [ there is ] no good ;

19.english_reference: and for the time of healing , and behold trouble !

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ עֵ֥ת מַרְפֵּ֖א וְ הִנֵּ֥ה בְעָתָֽה
traditions.LXX: εἰς καιρὸν ἰάσεως , καὶ ἰδοὺ ταραχή .
traditions.VUL: et tempus curatiónis , et ecce turbátio .
traditions.KJV: and for the time of healing , and behold trouble !

20.english_reference: We acknowledge , O LORD , our wickedness , [ and ] the iniquity of our fathers

traditions.WLC: יָדַ֧עְנוּ יְהוָ֛ה רִשְׁעֵ֖ נוּ עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבוֹתֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.LXX: ἔγνωμεν , Κύριε , ἁμαρτήματα ἡμῶν , ἀδικίας πατέρων ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Cognóvimus Dómine impietátes nostras , iniquitátes patrum nostrórum ,
traditions.KJV: We acknowledge , O LORD , our wickedness , [ and ] the iniquity of our fathers :

20.english_reference: for we have sinned against thee

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לָֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν ἐναντίον σου .
traditions.VUL: quia peccávimus tibi .
traditions.KJV: for we have sinned against thee .

21.english_reference: Do not abhor [ us ] , for thy name ’s sake

traditions.WLC: אַל תִּנְאַץ֙ לְמַ֣עַן שִׁמְ ךָ֔
traditions.LXX: κόπασον διὰ τὸ ὄνομά σου ,
traditions.VUL: Ne des nos in oppróbrium propter nomen tuum ,
traditions.KJV: Do not abhor [ us ] , for thy name ’s sake ,

21.english_reference: do not disgrace the throne of thy glory

traditions.VUL: neque fácias nobis contuméliam sólii glóriæ tuæ :
traditions.KJV: do not disgrace the throne of thy glory :

21.english_reference: remember , break not thy covenant with us

traditions.WLC: זְכֹ֕ר אַל תָּפֵ֥ר בְּרִֽיתְ ךָ֖ אִתָּֽ נוּ
traditions.LXX: μνήσθητι , μὴ διασκεδάσῃς τὴν διαθήκην σου τὴν μεθ᾽ ἡμῶν ·
traditions.VUL: recordáre , ne írritum fácias fœdus tuum nobíscum .
traditions.KJV: remember , break not thy covenant with us .

22.english_reference: Are there [ any ] among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ יֵ֨שׁ בְּ הַבְלֵ֤י הַ גּוֹיִם֙ מַגְשִׁמִ֔ים

traditions.KJV: or can the heavens give showers ? [ art ]
